$comment: PRD: 'Games are configuration, not code'. Games are seeded from here in Sprint 4. Each game defines: id fields, supported formats, result schema, required proof, tiebreak rules. Launch each game with one or two formats only. Stage 1 formats are Duel (1v1) only (PRD: Team and Lobby are Stage 4); see docs/decisions/0002-launch-formats.md.

formats.name: 1v1 Duel
formats.tiebreakRules: Higher goals scored wins. If goals equal, match result stands as submitted.

formats.name: Multiplayer 1v1 Duel
formats.tiebreakRules: Higher kills wins. If kills equal, match result stands as submitted.

formats.name: 1v1 Team Deathmatch Duel
formats.tiebreakRules: Played 1v1, either the in-lobby 1v1 Arena challenge (Warehouse) or a custom TDM room. Higher kills wins. If kills are equal, the match result stands as submitted.
